exposure: Duration of second stage of labor
outcome: Prevalence of levator ani muscle (LAM) avulsion
finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with levator ani muscle avulsion, with the highest prevalence observed in forceps-assisted deliveries, followed by vacuum-assisted deliveries, and the lowest in spontaneous deliveries.
mod_finding: The incidence of levator ani muscle avulsion is lower in spontaneous delivery and significantly increases when an instrument is used to assist delivery, especially forceps.
